root_cause: The existing pure evaluatePromotionCandidate function accepted two arbitrary string evidenceRefs and true boolean quality/security/regression flags as sufficient to emit promotable=true/PROMOTE, without requiring any independently verified provider/run evidence at the exact candidate revision. A caller could also pass requiredGates=[] and minEvidence=0 to weaken validation.
fix: Pure self-improvement candidate evaluator now requires at least two distinct independent evidence attestations returned by a supplied trusted verification function, matching exact 40-char candidate source SHA, evidence ID, validated observation timestamp and allowed verification authority; exceptions, self-assertion, mismatch, future timestamps and duplicates fail closed. Minimum quality/security/regression gates cannot be removed by optional arguments. The PROMOTE decision remains an advisory evaluated candidate, with releaseAuthorized=false and protectedReleaseRequired=true; real provider/review/production gates remain separate.
prevention_rule: All optimization and new-model agents must separate claimed evidence references from externally verified evidence receipts. A non-empty string ID, self-awarded 'verified' flag, a successful pg_cron or compiler-ready source is not a verified improvement or authorization to publish. No repeat scheduler, new registry, direct production DDL, customer-value fabricated entries, security waiver, provider consent bypass or CI bypass. Existing canonical #2750 and #4358 remain owner.

invariants: two independent verifiable receipts from trusted callback, not two strings
exact candidate source SHA and evidence identity and observation freshness
no duplicate refs or self-attested proof
no false green on provider errors
quality security regression mandatory regardless of caller overrides
advisory promotion result never release authority
protected Required/CodeQL and existing production approval unchanged

terminal_rule: Source live only after protected exact-head Required and CodeQL, protected merge, main readback, actual Brain skill projection and runtime evaluation on trusted provider receipts; no assertion that any of the nine existing candidates is already measurable or customer verified.
